name: smwgraphics-pokemon-inspired-boss-pack
title: Pokemon-Inspired Boss Pack 01
description:
This is a collection of Pokemon-inspired reskins drawn by me, GoobieDoobie, for the Ultimate Noob Sprite v1.3.4.3.4 .
The idea came from autisticsceptile1993, who sent me a List of 18 pokemons that are the Base-Inspiration for this collection.
I made 18 reskins, but the file would be too big, so I will upload them in 3 parts, each one containing 6. This one includes:

-Beartic-Inspired
-Carbink-Inspired
-Hatterene-Inspired
-Heracross-Inspired
-Magcargo-Inspired
-Marowak-Inspired

If you want to use all 3 animations of each Boss, look into the ReadMe file, the instructions are under 'How to use'.

A credit to me & Iceguy would be appreciated. And also to autisticsceptile1993, without his request, these Characters would've never existed in the first place.
